description: This file defines the 'Faq' class within the Goteo project, representing Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) entries. It includes methods for retrieving, validating, saving, and deleting FAQ entries, as well as managing their order and categories.

classes.name: Faq
classes.description: Model class representing FAQ entries with methods for CRUD operations, ordering, and categorization.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields ('title' and 'description') that are language-dependent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single FAQ entry by ID, optionally with a specified language.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all FAQ entries within a specified section and language.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the FAQ object's essential fields before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the FAQ entry to the database after validation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a FAQ entry by ID and node.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves the FAQ entry up in order within its section.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves the FAQ entry down in order within its section.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Determines the next order position for a new FAQ entry in a section.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Returns an array of defined FAQ sections with their display labels.

methods.name: colors
methods.description: Returns an array of colors associated with each FAQ section.
